objects.name: christmas-spirit-text
objects.text:
Stejně jako se tržnice liší od klasických nákupních center, hledali jsme i my alternativu k jejich typickému způsobu výzdoby. Zvolili jsme proto jednoduchost a přírodní materiály, které zdobné budovy tržnice jemně doplní.

Konstrukce je odkazem na tradiční doškové střechy, doplněné o moderní technologie. V doškách jsou totiž kromě rákosu i optická vlákna, díky nimž strom při soumraku kouzelně ožívá. Možná se bude zdát, že světélkují samotné konce stébel. Že by je rozsvěcel Duch Vánoc?

title: THROUGH THE FOREST
description: Landscape architecture studio project focused on permeability and ecological continuity in Prague 11.
annotation: The project was created on the basis of a common vision for Prague 11. Its main element is a green net, connecting three vaste forests that surround the area. The proposal is a response to the issue of permeability of the territory and a part of the net. The project connects the Kunratice Forest with the Hostivař-Záběhlice Park. Therefore, it uses a stripe of free space around roads. Benefits of the proposal: interconnection of areas, possibility of migration of species, use of vague areas, pedestrian safety, expansion of forest area and new areas for recreation. The result is a terrain mass that rises like a wave to span two roads, absorbing the rest inside. It’s liquid consistency adapts to the existing terrain and and partially hides a building of a large shopping center.

objects.name: vegetace-text
objects.text:
VEGETACE 12

Druhové složení zamýšleného lesního porostu je odvozeno od stávajícího pestrého složení přilehlých lesů, jejichž části jsou kvůli svým cenným druhovým společenstvím chráněné.

ideální (přirozené) zastoupení dřevin pro tuto oblast :
- Quercus sp. / dub 68%
- Fagus sylvatica / buk lesní 20%
- Abies alba / jedle bělokorá 3%
- Betula pendula / bříza bělokorá 2%
- Carpinus betulus / habr obecný 2%
- Alnus glutinosa / olše lepkavá 2%
- Fraxinus excelsior / jasan ztepilý 1%
- Pinus sylvestris / borovice lesní 1%
- Tilia cordata / lípa srdčitá 1%

Procentuální zastoupení druhů je orientační, lokálně by se v místech navrhovaných ploch lišilo podle vhodnosti stanovištních podmínek pro konkrétní druhy.

objects.name: vnitrni-funkce-text
objects.text:
VNITŘNÍ FUNKCE 13

Jelikož jde o velkou terénní masu, tak při odečtení hloubky vrchní vrstvy zeminy pro pohodlnou existenci lesního porostu zbývá ještě prostor uvnitř (množství se liší v různých částech tělesa podle jeho výšky).

Část zabere zapuštění menších komunikací, zbytek by bylo možné využít :

- jako dodatečné parkovací domy (málo prosvětlené části)
- jako kanceláře, popřípadě bytové jednotky se službami v dolním parteru (nejvíce prosvětlené, konkávně prohnuté části)
- jako skladové prostory pro přilehlé obchodní centrum (neprosvětlené části)

title: ABSTRACT.
description: Urban tissue shaped through abstraction from the landscape, centered around a hilltop community center and pedestrian axes.
annotation: The aim of the design was to emerge from the landscape. This was accomplished through a process of abstraction—extracting the essential elements and using them as the foundation for the work, ensuring a relation to the place. The created urban tissue is shaped as an interpretation of the landscape, for it to make the place more readable for its visitors, fostering a deeper emotional connection. Centralized to the top of the hill with a community center, the two axes continue as pedestrian streets, referring to the main street in the old city center. Important was the usage of the partly opened block, with apartment buildings on the edges and row-houses in the middle. Therefore, the sun exposure and sheltering from the wind is achieved, as well as the cosy courtyards creating communities.

title: Steep Garden Realization
description: Realization of a steep family house garden in Prague's Střešovice district.
annotation: This project is a redevelopment design of a garden around a family house in Prague's Střešovice district, subsequently processed into detailed project documentation. The project’s plot is very steep, so the design works with the terrain to create more usable spaces. The concept is based on simplicity, which is ideal for the small spaces of the garden. The aesthetic of the design is inspired by early 20th-century urban villa gardens, for example by the use of evergreen trees. The project creates cozy rooms that invite you to spend the time in the garden, rather than just looking at it. Despite its small size, the garden offers spaces for socializing or quiet solitude for all house residents.

title: GROWING-THROUGH
description: Two-year outdoor installation for the International Garden Festival at Les Jardins de Métis.
annotation: A design for a two-year outdoor installation created for the International Garden Festival at Les Jardins de Métis (Reford Gardens) with the theme 'BORDERS'. The installation illustrates how nature deals with artificial boundaries created by humans. Concrete objects placed in conflict with willow patches demonstrate various spatial concepts of barriers and their overcoming. By using willow rods that will take root and grow through the whole time of the exhibition, the installation continuously evolves, showing how the environment adapts to the impacts of insensitive human interventions.

title: Kladno Krematorium
description: Landscape architecture studio project for a dignified and recreational landscape around the Kladno crematorium.
annotation: Crematorium now exists only as a technical building, that looks like a car repair shop surrounded by shrubs and rests of orchard. The project tends to create a pleasant space, which can be visit both for dignifiedly take part with departed and for recreation, but with condition that these intents wouldn’t disturb each other. One of the basis of the project is an elegant wall, that hides the crematorium’s building. Then there is an idea of two worlds, bordered with a water ribbon. Inside, there is a place of peaceful rest with three scattering meadow shaped as grass pillows. Dynamic path in dialog with water ribbon are symbolizing the infinite cycle of life. Both features are changing constantly, bringing the idea that the life of the grievers is not ending, just changing.

title: CONCEPT OF SEMNĚVICE LANDSCAPE
description: Landscape concept for Semněvice based on a multi-layer territorial analysis.
annotation: Based on a detailed analysis of the landscape of Semněvice, a vision for the area was proposed — SemněVISION, and a Landscape Concept of Semněvice was prepared. It aims to grasp the landscape comprehensively as a whole, to establish principles and methods of rational and sustainable use and interventions so that it would prosper and people would live well in it. The landscape concept was elaborated in detail in four layers based on the needs and problems of the Semněvice landscape: the road network, the intramural area, agriculture and the water regime. This team project is followed by individual projects developing the following layers: THE LANDSCAPE AROUND SEMNĚVICE, Through the Village Under the Hillage, WATER FLOW, Heart of Semněvice, AGRI-SEMNĚ-CULTURE, REWATERIZATION, OUT-WATERING.

objects.name: kostel-sv-jiri-description
objects.text: Stavbu s polygonálním závěrem zaklenutým žebrovou klenbou a osvětleným zčásti ještě gotickými okny doplňuje vyosená mohutná hranolová věž. Gotická loď byla před rokem 1757 prodloužena, nově sklenuta a doplněna nástropními malbami od horšovskotýnského malíře A. Krause. Vnitřní zařízení je barokní z poloviny 18. století. Při rozsáhlých opravách kostela v letech 1993-1995 byla zpevněna staticky narušená věž a překryta střecha.

title: REWATERIZATION
description: A Semněvice water regime revitalisation proposal developed from the landscape concept.
annotation: The project arises from group work, in which a VISION was proposed and a LANDSCAPE CONCEPT was created based on an analysis of the territory of the Semněvice municipality. Its aim was to grasp the landscape as a whole and to establish principles and methods for rational and sustainable use, so that it could thrive and people could live well in it. The proposal is an application of principles established in the concept to a specific area, an example of revitalising local water regime. The work is based on the real needs of the community. The presentation of the proposal ensures that the issue of water in the landscape is adequately explained, as it is not just theoretical work for the academic community but primarily a real initiative for a specific municipality and its citizens.
